# Generated by herramientas/make_prisoners.pl. One slot per captured general of a human player: global event target mdr_pow_<n> and
# global variables mdr_pow_owner_<n> (0 free), _from_ (origin id), _status_ (0 war, 1 war over), _rank_, _skill_, _atk_, _def_, _pla_, _log_, _opp_, _face_, _t1_ to _t4_.
# The menu shows the player's selected slot, copied to the country variables mdr_pow_sel_*.

# General scope. Input: temps mdr_pow_origin, mdr_pow_opp, global.mdr_pow_holder_now.
mdr_pow_register = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 1 }
	if = { limit = { skill > 1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { skill > 8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_skill = 9 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 1 }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { attack_skill_level > 8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_atk = 9 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 1 }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { defense_skill_level > 8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_def = 9 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 1 }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { planning_skill_level > 8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_pla = 9 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 1 }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { logistics_skill_level > 8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_log = 9 } }
	mdr_pow_read_face = yes
	mdr_pow_read_traits = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_op = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_opdays = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_res = 45 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_base = 45 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_coop = 30 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_opp = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_res = 80 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_base = 80 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_coop = 5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_rank = 1 }
	if = { limit = { is_field_marshal = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_r_rank = 2 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = mdr_pow_r_skill }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_1 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_1 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_2 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_2 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_3 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_3 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_4 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_4 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_5 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_5 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_6 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_6 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_7 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_7 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_8 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_8 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 8 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_9 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_9 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 9 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_10 < mdr_pow_low } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_low = global.mdr_pow_skill_10 } set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 0 } }
			release_from_captivity = yes
			clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 1 } } mdr_pow_exile_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 2 } } mdr_pow_exile_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 3 } } mdr_pow_exile_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 4 } } mdr_pow_exile_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 5 } } mdr_pow_exile_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 6 } } mdr_pow_exile_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 7 } } mdr_pow_exile_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 8 } } mdr_pow_exile_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 9 } } mdr_pow_exile_9 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 10 } } mdr_pow_exile_10 = yes }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 1 } } mdr_pow_write_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 2 } } mdr_pow_write_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 3 } } mdr_pow_write_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 4 } } mdr_pow_write_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 5 } } mdr_pow_write_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 6 } } mdr_pow_write_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 7 } } mdr_pow_write_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 8 } } mdr_pow_write_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 9 } } mdr_pow_write_9 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_slot = 10 } } mdr_pow_write_10 = yes }
}

# Origin scope, while it still exists: it is being annexed, so its generals' war is over.
mdr_pow_mark_annexed = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_1 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_1 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_2 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_2 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_3 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_3 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_4 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_4 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_5 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_5 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_6 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_6 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_7 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_7 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_8 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_8 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_9 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_9 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_10 = THIS.id } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = 0 } } } set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_10 = 1 } }
}

# Country scope: the wars behind our prisoners, daily for players.
mdr_pow_slots_update = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_9 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = THIS.id } } mdr_pow_check_10 = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_count > 0 } } mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes }
}

# Country scope: keeps a valid selection and copies it for the menu.
mdr_pow_sel_refresh = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 3 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 4 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 6 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 7 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 8 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 9 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 10 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = THIS.id } } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_4 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_6 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_9 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 0 } check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = THIS.id } } set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_skill = global.mdr_pow_skill_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_atk = global.mdr_pow_atk_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_def = global.mdr_pow_def_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_pla = global.mdr_pow_pla_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_log = global.mdr_pow_log_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_face = global.mdr_pow_face_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t1 = global.mdr_pow_t1_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t2 = global.mdr_pow_t2_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t3 = global.mdr_pow_t3_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t4 = global.mdr_pow_t4_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_res = global.mdr_pow_res_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_coop = global.mdr_pow_coop_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_base = global.mdr_pow_base_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_op = global.mdr_pow_op_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_opdays = global.mdr_pow_opdays_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_status = global.mdr_pow_status_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_opp = global.mdr_pow_opp_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_res_bar = mdr_pow_sel_res }
		round_variable = mdr_pow_sel_res_bar
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_coop_bar = mdr_pow_sel_coop }
		round_variable = mdr_pow_sel_coop_bar
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_sel = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_skill = global.mdr_pow_skill_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_atk = global.mdr_pow_atk_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_def = global.mdr_pow_def_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_pla = global.mdr_pow_pla_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_log = global.mdr_pow_log_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_face = global.mdr_pow_face_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t1 = global.mdr_pow_t1_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t2 = global.mdr_pow_t2_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t3 = global.mdr_pow_t3_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_t4 = global.mdr_pow_t4_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_res = global.mdr_pow_res_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_coop = global.mdr_pow_coop_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_sel_base = global.mdr_pow_base_2 }

mdr_pow_write_1 = {
	save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_1
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_1 = mdr_pow_origin }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_rank_1 = mdr_pow_r_rank }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_1 = mdr_pow_r_skill }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_atk_1 = mdr_pow_r_atk }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_def_1 = mdr_pow_r_def }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_pla_1 = mdr_pow_r_pla }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_log_1 = mdr_pow_r_log }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_face_1 = mdr_pow_r_face }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t1_1 = mdr_pow_r_t1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t2_1 = mdr_pow_r_t2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t3_1 = mdr_pow_r_t3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t4_1 = mdr_pow_r_t4 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = mdr_pow_r_res }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = mdr_pow_r_coop }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_base_1 = mdr_pow_r_base }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = mdr_pow_r_op }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_1 = mdr_pow_r_opdays }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opp_1 = mdr_pow_opp }
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = {
		add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = 1 }
		mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes
	}
}

mdr_pow_clear_1 = {
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = { add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = -1 } }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
}

mdr_pow_opdone_1 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = -14 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = -5 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = -8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = -9 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 2 } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = -3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = 22 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_res_1 min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_1 min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 = 0 }
}

mdr_pow_check_1 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_1 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_1 = -1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_1 < 1 } } mdr_pow_opdone_1 = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 < global.mdr_pow_base_1 } } add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_1 = 0.29 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_1 = -0.29 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_1 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_1 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_1 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_1 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_1 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

mdr_pow_use_1 = {
	add_political_power = -96
	event_target:mdr_pow_1 = { save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_news }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_face = global.mdr_pow_face_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year days = 365 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 1 }
	event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = ROOT
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = mdr_doubtful_loyalty days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { add_war_support = -0.03 } }
	mdr_pow_clear_1 = yes
	country_event = { id = mdr_prisoners.5 }
}

mdr_pow_execute_1 = {
	add_political_power = -47
	event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = {
			add_war_support = 0.02
			ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 4 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
	mdr_pow_clear_1 = yes
}

mdr_pow_exile_1 = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 }
	var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_government = PREV
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_1 } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_1 } }
				NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_owner_1 = { has_war_with = PREV } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
		}
	}
	event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = event_target:mdr_pow_exile_to
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_1 = yes
}

mdr_pow_trial_1 = {
	add_political_power = 58
	add_war_support = 0.02
	event_target:mdr_pow_1 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_1 = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			}
		}
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_1 = yes
}

		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_2 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_2 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_2 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_2 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_2 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

mdr_pow_use_2 = {
	add_political_power = -96
	event_target:mdr_pow_2 = { save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_news }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_face = global.mdr_pow_face_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_2 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year days = 365 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 1 }
	event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = ROOT
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = mdr_doubtful_loyalty days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { add_war_support = -0.03 } }
	mdr_pow_clear_2 = yes
	country_event = { id = mdr_prisoners.5 }
}

mdr_pow_execute_2 = {
	add_political_power = -47
	event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = {
			add_war_support = 0.02
			ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 4 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
	mdr_pow_clear_2 = yes
}

mdr_pow_exile_2 = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 }
	var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_government = PREV
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_2 } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_2 } }
				NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_owner_2 = { has_war_with = PREV } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
		}
	}
	event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = event_target:mdr_pow_exile_to
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_2 = yes
}

mdr_pow_trial_2 = {
	add_political_power = 58
	add_war_support = 0.02
	event_target:mdr_pow_2 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_2 = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			}
		}
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_2 = yes
}

mdr_pow_write_3 = {
	save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_3
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_3 = mdr_pow_origin }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_rank_3 = mdr_pow_r_rank }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_3 = mdr_pow_r_skill }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_atk_3 = mdr_pow_r_atk }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_def_3 = mdr_pow_r_def }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_pla_3 = mdr_pow_r_pla }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_log_3 = mdr_pow_r_log }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_face_3 = mdr_pow_r_face }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t1_3 = mdr_pow_r_t1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t2_3 = mdr_pow_r_t2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t3_3 = mdr_pow_r_t3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t4_3 = mdr_pow_r_t4 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = mdr_pow_r_res }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = mdr_pow_r_coop }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_base_3 = mdr_pow_r_base }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = mdr_pow_r_op }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_3 = mdr_pow_r_opdays }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opp_3 = mdr_pow_opp }
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = {
		add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = 1 }
		mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes
	}
}

mdr_pow_clear_3 = {
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = { add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = -1 } }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_3 = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
}

mdr_pow_opdone_3 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = -14 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = -5 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = -8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = -9 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 2 } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = -3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = 22 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_res_3 min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_3 min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 = 0 }
}

mdr_pow_check_3 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_3 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_3 = -1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_3 < 1 } } mdr_pow_opdone_3 = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 < global.mdr_pow_base_3 } } add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_3 = 0.29 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_3 = -0.29 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_3 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_3 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_3 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_3 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_3 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_3 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_3 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_3 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

	save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_5
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_5 = mdr_pow_origin }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_rank_5 = mdr_pow_r_rank }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_5 = mdr_pow_r_skill }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_atk_5 = mdr_pow_r_atk }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_def_5 = mdr_pow_r_def }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_pla_5 = mdr_pow_r_pla }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_log_5 = mdr_pow_r_log }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_face_5 = mdr_pow_r_face }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t1_5 = mdr_pow_r_t1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t2_5 = mdr_pow_r_t2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t3_5 = mdr_pow_r_t3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t4_5 = mdr_pow_r_t4 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = mdr_pow_r_res }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = mdr_pow_r_coop }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_base_5 = mdr_pow_r_base }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = mdr_pow_r_op }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_5 = mdr_pow_r_opdays }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opp_5 = mdr_pow_opp }
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = {
		add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = 1 }
		mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes
	}
}

mdr_pow_clear_5 = {
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = { add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = -1 } }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
}

mdr_pow_opdone_5 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = -14 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = -5 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = -8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = -9 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 2 } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = -3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = 22 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_res_5 min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_5 min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 = 0 }
}

mdr_pow_check_5 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_5 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_5 = -1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_5 < 1 } } mdr_pow_opdone_5 = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 < global.mdr_pow_base_5 } } add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_5 = 0.29 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_5 = -0.29 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_5 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_5 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_5 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_5 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_5 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

mdr_pow_use_5 = {
	add_political_power = -96
	event_target:mdr_pow_5 = { save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_news }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_face = global.mdr_pow_face_5 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_5 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year days = 365 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 1 }
	event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = ROOT
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = mdr_doubtful_loyalty days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { add_war_support = -0.03 } }
	mdr_pow_clear_5 = yes
	country_event = { id = mdr_prisoners.5 }
}

mdr_pow_execute_5 = {
	add_political_power = -47
	event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = {
			add_war_support = 0.02
			ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 4 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
	mdr_pow_clear_5 = yes
}

mdr_pow_exile_5 = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 }
	var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_government = PREV
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_5 } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_5 } }
				NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_owner_5 = { has_war_with = PREV } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
		}
	}
	event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = event_target:mdr_pow_exile_to
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_5 = yes
}

mdr_pow_trial_5 = {
	add_political_power = 58
	add_war_support = 0.02
	event_target:mdr_pow_5 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_5 = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			}
		}
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_5 = yes
}

		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_7 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_7 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_7 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

mdr_pow_use_7 = {
	add_political_power = -96
	event_target:mdr_pow_7 = { save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_news }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_face = global.mdr_pow_face_7 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_7 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year days = 365 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 1 }
	event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = ROOT
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = mdr_doubtful_loyalty days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { add_war_support = -0.03 } }
	mdr_pow_clear_7 = yes
	country_event = { id = mdr_prisoners.5 }
}

mdr_pow_execute_7 = {
	add_political_power = -47
	event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = {
			add_war_support = 0.02
			ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 4 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
	mdr_pow_clear_7 = yes
}

mdr_pow_exile_7 = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 }
	var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_government = PREV
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_7 } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_7 } }
				NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_owner_7 = { has_war_with = PREV } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
		}
	}
	event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = event_target:mdr_pow_exile_to
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_7 = yes
}

mdr_pow_trial_7 = {
	add_political_power = 58
	add_war_support = 0.02
	event_target:mdr_pow_7 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_7 = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			}
		}
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_7 = yes
}

mdr_pow_write_8 = {
	save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_8
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = global.mdr_pow_holder_now }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_8 = mdr_pow_origin }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_rank_8 = mdr_pow_r_rank }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_8 = mdr_pow_r_skill }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_atk_8 = mdr_pow_r_atk }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_def_8 = mdr_pow_r_def }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_pla_8 = mdr_pow_r_pla }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_log_8 = mdr_pow_r_log }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_face_8 = mdr_pow_r_face }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t1_8 = mdr_pow_r_t1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t2_8 = mdr_pow_r_t2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t3_8 = mdr_pow_r_t3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t4_8 = mdr_pow_r_t4 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = mdr_pow_r_res }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = mdr_pow_r_coop }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_base_8 = mdr_pow_r_base }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = mdr_pow_r_op }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_8 = mdr_pow_r_opdays }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opp_8 = mdr_pow_opp }
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = {
		add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = 1 }
		mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes
	}
}

mdr_pow_clear_8 = {
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = { add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = -1 } }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_8 = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
}

mdr_pow_opdone_8 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = -14 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = -5 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = -8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = -9 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 2 } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = -3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = 22 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_res_8 min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_8 min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 = 0 }
}

mdr_pow_check_8 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_8 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_8 = -1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_8 < 1 } } mdr_pow_opdone_8 = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 < global.mdr_pow_base_8 } } add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_8 = 0.29 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_8 = -0.29 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_8 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_8 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_8 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_8 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_8 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_8 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_8 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_8 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_from_10 = mdr_pow_origin }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_10 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_rank_10 = mdr_pow_r_rank }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_skill_10 = mdr_pow_r_skill }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_atk_10 = mdr_pow_r_atk }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_def_10 = mdr_pow_r_def }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_pla_10 = mdr_pow_r_pla }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_log_10 = mdr_pow_r_log }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_face_10 = mdr_pow_r_face }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t1_10 = mdr_pow_r_t1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t2_10 = mdr_pow_r_t2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t3_10 = mdr_pow_r_t3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_t4_10 = mdr_pow_r_t4 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = mdr_pow_r_res }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = mdr_pow_r_coop }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_base_10 = mdr_pow_r_base }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = mdr_pow_r_op }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_10 = mdr_pow_r_opdays }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opp_10 = mdr_pow_opp }
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = {
		add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = 1 }
		mdr_pow_sel_refresh = yes
	}
}

mdr_pow_clear_10 = {
	var:global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = { add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_count = -1 } }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
}

mdr_pow_opdone_10 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = -14 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = -5 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = -8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = -9 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 2 } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = -3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = 15 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = 22 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_res_10 min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_10 min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 = 0 }
}

mdr_pow_check_10 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_op_10 > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_10 = -1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_opdays_10 < 1 } } mdr_pow_opdone_10 = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 < global.mdr_pow_base_10 } } add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_res_10 = 0.29 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_coop_10 = -0.29 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdr_pow_coop_10 min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_10 = 0 } OR = { has_war = no NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { has_war_with = ROOT } } } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war AND = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_lost_war } } } } }
			event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
				release_from_captivity = yes
				clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
			}
			mdr_pow_clear_10 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_10 = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdr_pow_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_pow_status_10 = 1 } var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } }
		event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
			if = { limit = { is_general_captured = no } capture_by = ROOT }
		}
	}
}

mdr_pow_use_10 = {
	add_political_power = -96
	event_target:mdr_pow_10 = { save_global_event_target_as = mdr_pow_news }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_face = global.mdr_pow_face_10 }
	set_variable = { global.mdr_pow_news_rank = global.mdr_pow_rank_10 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_pow_recruit_year days = 365 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_pow_recruits = 1 }
	event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = ROOT
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = mdr_doubtful_loyalty days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } } var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { add_war_support = -0.03 } }
	mdr_pow_clear_10 = yes
	country_event = { id = mdr_prisoners.5 }
}

mdr_pow_execute_10 = {
	add_political_power = -47
	event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = {
			add_war_support = 0.02
			ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 4 } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
	mdr_pow_clear_10 = yes
}

mdr_pow_exile_10 = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 }
	var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_government = PREV
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_10 } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pow_placed = 0 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.mdr_pow_owner_10 } }
				NOT = { var:global.mdr_pow_owner_10 = { has_war_with = PREV } }
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdr_pow_exile_to
		}
	}
	event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		clr_unit_leader_flag = mdr_pow
		set_nationality = event_target:mdr_pow_exile_to
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_10 = yes
}

mdr_pow_trial_10 = {
	add_political_power = 58
	add_war_support = 0.02
	event_target:mdr_pow_10 = {
		release_from_captivity = yes
		retire = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.mdr_pow_from_10 = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdr_show_trial }
			}
		}
	}
	mdr_pow_clear_10 = yes
}
